capabilities: paint terrain on an endless hex map one hex at a time
add features such as roads and rivers and name hexes
track a player or party token on the map
add custom tilesets as folders of PNG files
configure map behavior through plugin settings
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer and manual installation of files into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tool for drawing and exploring an expanding hex map for tabletop campaigns or worldbuilding.
summary: Endless hex-crawl map for TTRPG worldbuilding: paint terrain hexes, add roads, rivers and names, and track a party token.
